kpis.description_fr: SanDisk standalone = pure-play flash storage NAND (cartes SD, USB, SSD client + enterprise). Spin-off Western Digital fév 2025.
kpis.description_en: SanDisk standalone = pure-play NAND flash storage (SD cards, USB, client + enterprise SSDs). Western Digital spin-off Feb 2025.

kpis.description_fr: JV fabrication NAND avec Kioxia (Japon). Partage technologie + capex Yokkaichi + Kitakami. Co-leader NAND avec Samsung.
kpis.description_en: NAND fabrication JV with Kioxia (Japan). Shared tech + capex Yokkaichi + Kitakami. Co-leader NAND with Samsung.

kpis.description_fr: Client SSD (PC, laptops) ~45 % du CA. Cycle PC + cycle NAND. Recovery PC 2024.
kpis.description_en: Client SSD (PC, laptops) ~45% of revenue. PC cycle + NAND cycle. PC recovery 2024.

kpis.description_fr: Enterprise SSD ~25 % du CA. Tailwind IA datacenter (training + inference) drives high-capacity NAND demand.
kpis.description_en: Enterprise SSD ~25% of revenue. AI datacenter tailwind (training + inference) drives high-capacity NAND demand.

kpis.description_fr: Retail/Removable = SD cards + USB drives + SanDisk-branded consumer. ~30 % du CA. Marges premium brand.
kpis.description_en: Retail/Removable = SD cards + USB drives + SanDisk-branded consumer. ~30% of revenue. Premium brand margins.

notes: SanDisk spun off from Western Digital fév 2025. Pas d'historique 5 ans standalone.
